title: Oven Roasted Portuguese Cheese Lasagna
description: A comforting Portuguese dish featuring garlic granules and a blend of cheeses, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is made in a wok and serves 6 people.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded portuguese cheese, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese.
In a separate bowl, mix the garlic granules, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beaten eggs to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the garlic and oil mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
In a wok, create a thin layer of the cheese mixture on the bottom.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the cheese mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the wok with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
